comment:
* Various special-case charset conversions (for performance).
 *
 * @hide internal use only

methods.name: public static native byte[] toAsciiBytes(String s, int offset, int length)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new byte array containing the bytes corresponding to the characters in the given
     * string, encoded in US-ASCII. Unrepresentable characters are replaced by (byte) '?'.

methods.name: public static native byte[] toIsoLatin1Bytes(String s, int offset, int length)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new byte array containing the bytes corresponding to the characters in the given
     * string, encoded in ISO-8859-1. Unrepresentable characters are replaced by (byte) '?'.

methods.name: public static native byte[] toUtf8Bytes(String s, int offset, int length)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new byte array containing the bytes corresponding to the characters in the given
     * string, encoded in UTF-8. All characters are representable in UTF-8.

methods.name: public static byte[] toBigEndianUtf16Bytes(String s, int offset, int length)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new byte array containing the bytes corresponding to the characters in the given
     * string, encoded in UTF-16BE. All characters are representable in UTF-16BE.

methods.name: public static native void asciiBytesToChars(byte[] bytes, int offset, int length, char[] chars)
